Three magic users are plotting in a tower full of undead in the desert. Climb the {wiki:Triangle Tower} floor by floor, past Skeletons, Ghouls, Demon Skeletons and Stalkers, and open the box at the top to receive a {item:Garlic Necklace}, a {item:Dwarven Ring} and two {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}.
